# Strava
> Strava is a social fitness platform for tracking, analyzing, and sharing running, cycling, hiking, walking, and other athletic activities.

Strava combines GPS activity tracking, route planning, training analysis, maps, challenges, and community features across its mobile app and website for athletes worldwide.

## Core Sports
- [Running](https://www.strava.com/sports/running): Running-focused tracking, route planning, training insights, and community features.
- [Cycling](https://www.strava.com/sports/cycling): Cycling activity tracking, route discovery, performance analysis, and ride sharing.
- [Walking](https://www.strava.com/sports/walking): Walking activity logging, trail exploration, and social motivation tools.
- [Hiking](https://www.strava.com/sports/hiking): Hiking GPS tracking, trail discovery, and outdoor activity sharing.

## Product Features
- [Features](https://www.strava.com/features): Overview of Strava tracking, analysis, safety, and community capabilities.
- [Maps](https://www.strava.com/maps): Explore routes, terrain, and activity maps for planning and discovery.
- [Challenges](https://www.strava.com/challenges): Join community challenges to stay motivated and earn achievements.
- [Subscription](https://www.strava.com/subscribe?origin=website_header): Premium membership with advanced training, safety, and route-planning tools.

- [Hiking](https://www.strava.com/sports/hiking): Hiking trail exploration and outdoor route inspiration.
- [Walking](https://www.strava.com/sports/walking): Walking route ideas and local trail discovery.
